GGU

Indie Mobile Game Studio

Small games.
Big fun.

GGU Games is an indie studio making small mobile games you come back to every day. From Idle Guild and Idle Blade Smith to Lazy Farm, our idle games keep growing even when the app is closed, on iOS and Android.

03 — STUDIO

About GGU

GGU Games is a small indie game studio that handles everything from game design and development to launch and updates.

We skip the blockbusters and make games you pull out on your commute, on a break, or before bed. Fun in five minutes, deeper the longer you play.

New games, dev updates and gameplay videos land on our YouTube channel first.
